title: Outlier: Unlimited Krillion Game
description: A free unlimited Krillion-style rare-answer trivia game with no daily cap. Name something that fits the category; the rarer your correct answer, the further your cat pilot's UFO flies over a pixel-art city.
how_to_play: You get a category (e.g. name a river, a cheese, an NBA team) and one answer. Type your answer: obvious picks score a little, rare correct picks score a lot. Your S/A/B grade decides how far the UFO flies. Play in any browser, desktop or mobile, no download.
